app_pitch: Local-first system for auditing, explaining, simulating, and documenting risks in AI-assisted business workflows.
privacy_warning: Do not paste real confidential, personal, financial, medical, legal, or production data. Use anonymized examples only.
ollama_unavailable: Local AI unavailable — deterministic report ready.
ollama_enrichment_used: Local narrative enrichment was added. Deterministic findings and scoring were unchanged.
ollama_enrichment_failed: Ollama did not provide advisory wording. Scores, findings, evidence, controls and simulations remain deterministic.
ollama_fallback_used: Local AI unavailable — deterministic report ready.
local_ai_unavailable_compact: Local AI unavailable — deterministic report ready.
local_ai_advisory_not_generated: Ollama did not provide advisory wording. Scores, findings, evidence, controls and simulations remain deterministic.
project_status: Local-first proof of concept. Analysis only; no production connections.
workflow_input_placeholder: Paste a workflow or choose a source above.
empty_input_warning: Add an anonymized workflow or select an example before running the audit.
ready_hint: Select an example or paste a custom workflow, then run the audit.
start_here_body: Choose a synthetic example or paste an anonymized workflow, then run the audit.
local_privacy_body: Analysis runs locally. User workflow text is saved only when you click the local save button.
next_after_analysis_body: Review evidence, simulate controls, save intentionally, then download Markdown or JSON.
start_workbench_subtitle: Paste, import, or describe the workflow to audit.
command_engine_body: Score, findings, evidence, controls, and simulation come from local rules.
command_local_body: No cloud API is required; optional Ollama is localhost-only and advisory.
command_session_body: Input is unsaved until you explicitly save a local report.
command_review_body: AIWRA supports review; it does not certify, approve, or deploy workflows.
main_example_selector_help: Choose custom input, example, or demo.
workflow_source_choice_help: Selected source fills the input below.
load_example_help: Load the selected synthetic example into the workflow input.
analyze_button_help: Run the local deterministic risk engine on the current workflow text.
workbench_status_subtitle: System state for this unsaved local session.
workbench_source_of_truth: Score, findings, evidence, controls, and simulation come from deterministic rules.
workbench_source_detail: Optional local AI can draft wording only.
workbench_privacy_detail: Use real data only when your local policy allows it.
workbench_local_ai_boundary: Local AI state: {state}. It can draft wording only and never changes deterministic results.
analysis_ready_state_body: The local deterministic engine is ready for this workflow text.
after_analysis_summary: The score and findings came from local deterministic rules. Review the evidence, simulate controls, then save only if you want local history.
controls_recommended_not_applied_caption: These controls are recommended from deterministic evidence. They are not applied or verified by AIWRA.
export_save_hint: Downloads are available immediately. Local history is created only after you click Save.
ollama_cloud_model_blocked: Cloud/proxy-like model names were detected. Advisory wording was not generated; deterministic results remain ready.
ollama_no_local_models: Ollama is reachable, but no local-only models were listed. Deterministic report ready.
ollama_model_missing: Ollama is reachable, but the selected model is not installed. Deterministic report ready.
ollama_cloud_models_detected: Cloud/proxy-like Ollama models were detected and are blocked for local-only enrichment.
reset_demo_db_warning: Reset deletes saved local reports and recreates synthetic seed data.
reset_demo_db_confirm: I understand this deletes saved local reports.
reset_demo_db_warning_v2: Reset deletes the local SQLite database at data/aiwra.db and recreates synthetic seed data.
reset_demo_db_short_warning: Danger reset is closed by default.
reset_demo_db_deletes: Deleted: saved local projects, workflows, assessments, findings, simulations, reports, and audit events stored in data/aiwra.db.
reset_demo_db_keeps: Not deleted: source code, docs, screenshots, tests, examples, knowledge-base JSON, and exported files outside the database.
reset_demo_db_backup: Back up data/aiwra.db first if you need saved history.
reset_demo_db_confirm_v2: I understand this deletes data/aiwra.db saved history.
dashboard_help: Dashboard metrics are built only from reports you intentionally saved in local SQLite.
dashboard_empty_state: No saved audits yet. Run an audit, save the report locally, then return here to see metrics.
dashboard_metric_note: Average raw risk uses deterministic matrix scores. Average reduction uses saved residual-risk simulations.
dashboard_small_sample_warning: This dashboard is based on very few saved reports. Treat averages as orientation, not trend evidence.
dashboard_sample_basis: Average based on saved reports in local SQLite.
dashboard_average_risk_help: Mean raw deterministic score, not a statistical trend.
dashboard_average_reduction_help: Mean simulated reduction from selected controls.
delete_project_warning: Deletes only the active project and its saved workflows, assessments, findings, simulations, and reports from local SQLite.
delete_project_confirm: I understand this permanently deletes the active project from local SQLite.
delete_demo_project_blocked: The synthetic demo project cannot be deleted individually. Use the separate demo database reset only if you intend to replace all saved local history.
clear_input_help: Clears the current text field only. It does not delete the current analysis or saved local history.
clear_session_confirm: Confirm clearing the current unsaved session.
clear_session_help: Clears current input, analysis, simulation, and generated session output. Saved SQLite history is not deleted.
demo_db_reset_success: Demo database reset with synthetic seed data.
run_audit_first: Run an audit before simulating residual risk.
no_controls_for_simulation: No controls were mapped from the current evidence.
control_card_limit: This is a recommended control, not evidence that the control is implemented.
save_analysis_before_simulation: Save the analysis first if you want this simulation in history.
no_reports_saved: No reports saved yet. Save from the Audit tab after analysis.
section_local_privacy_report: What is saved and what stays local
no_findings_explained: No evidence findings were detected from the submitted workflow. This does not prove the workflow is safe.
top_risks_caption: The highest-severity findings are shown first. Each one includes evidence, the local rule, confidence, and a recommended action.
findings_count_explained: Findings are attention points detected in the text. They are not proof by themselves.
finding_plain_sentence: The workflow may be risky because this evidence matched a local rule. A human should confirm whether it matters.
finding_metric_explanation: Attention points detected in the text; not proof by themselves.
raw_matrix_explanation_ui: Calculated by summing local risk-factor weights mapped from evidence.
explain_like_12_body: The app reviews the workflow against a deterministic local checklist. When it detects evidence such as customer data, external messages, or missing review, it adds local rule points. More points mean stronger human review is needed before automation.
human_responsibility_note: A human remains responsible because the app can miss context and cannot know your real business obligations.
raw_risk_metric_help: Calculated local rule score before selected protections.
residual_risk_metric_help: Simulated remaining score after selected protections. Not a guarantee.
reduction_metric_help: Simulated reduction from mapped control effects only.
none_detected: None detected from the submitted workflow.
no_weighted_factors: No weighted risk factors were detected.
cyber_risk_sensitive_data_exposure: Sensitive data exposure if prompts, drafts, or logs are not controlled.
cyber_risk_unreviewed_external_communica: Unreviewed external communication could expose incorrect or sensitive content.
cyber_risk_weak_auditability: Weak auditability could make decisions difficult to review later.
cyber_risk_excessive_automation_permissi: Excessive permissions could let automation exceed the intended advisory role.
cyber_risk_third_party_integration_risk: Third-party integration boundaries and data transfer need review.
cyber_risk_prompt_injection_risk: User-submitted text may contain prompt injection or misleading instructions.
cyber_risk_unauthorized_data_modificatio: Record changes require controls to prevent unauthorized modification.
cyber_risk_incorrect_security_alert_prio: Incorrect security alert prioritization may delay analyst response.
cyber_risk_over_automation_of_incident_r: Incident response should not be over-automated without analyst approval.
cyber_risk_missing_high_impact_approval: High-impact recommendations need explicit human approval.

privacy_risk_candidate_employee_data: Candidate or employee information may require stricter review.
privacy_risk_customer_data_in_workflow: Customer information may be exposed through drafts, logs, or messages.
privacy_risk_financial_data_in_workflow: Financial information may require additional access controls.
privacy_risk_medical_data_in_workflow: Health-related information should not be processed without specialist review.
privacy_risk_external_sharing_or_messagi: External sharing or messaging increases privacy exposure.
privacy_risk_data_minimization_gap: The workflow should define data minimization rules.
privacy_risk_retention_policy_gap: The workflow should define retention and deletion expectations.
privacy_risk_transparency_gap: Transparency, notice, or consent expectations may need review.
privacy_risk_automated_decision_impact: Automated decisions affecting people need human oversight.
privacy_risk_third_party_processing_risk: Third-party processing may introduce additional privacy obligations.

checkpoint_review_people_affecting_decis: Review decisions that affect candidates, employees, or customers.
checkpoint_review_financial_decisions: Review financial decisions or record changes before action.

checkpoint_review_health_workflows: Review medical or health-related workflows with qualified staff.
checkpoint_analyst_review_security_respo: Require analyst review before security escalation, closure, or response.
checkpoint_approve_record_changes: Approve record changes, deletion, closure, or irreversible actions.
checkpoint_review_third_party_actions: Review third-party or integration-triggered actions before execution.
checkpoint_validate_sensitive_data_use: Validate that sensitive data use is necessary and minimized.
checkpoint_approve_agent_permissions: Approve and limit any AI workflow permissions before use.
recommendation_summarize_workflow: Summarize workflow steps and produce internal checklists.
recommendation_classify_requests: Classify requests by type, urgency, and routing category.
recommendation_draft_internal_notes: Draft internal notes for human review.
recommendation_extract_non_sensitive_fie: Extract non-sensitive fields from anonymized text.
recommendation_draft_customer_response: Draft customer response suggestions for agent approval.
recommendation_suggest_escalation_catego: Suggest escalation categories for complex requests.
recommendation_summarize_candidate_mater: Summarize candidate material for HR review.
recommendation_prepare_interview_checkli: Prepare interview checklists and follow-up questions.
recommendation_summarize_alert_context: Summarize alert context for analyst triage.
recommendation_suggest_triage_questions: Suggest triage questions for security analysts.
recommendation_draft_customer_update: Draft customer updates for dispatcher approval.
recommendation_flag_operational_exceptio: Flag operational exceptions for human review.
recommendation_external_messages: External messages require approval before sending.
recommendation_record_changes: Record changes require approval and audit logging.
recommendation_financial_actions: Financial actions require authorized human approval.
recommendation_review_before_external_im: Review before any external or operational impact.
recommendation_irreversible_actions: Do not automate irreversible actions in this MVP.
recommendation_autonomous_incident_conta: Do not automate incident containment in this MVP.
recommendation_unreviewed_hr_decisions: Do not automate unreviewed HR decisions.
recommendation_secret_handling: Do not place secrets or credentials into prompts.
recommendation_unreviewed_high_impact_ac: Do not automate high-impact actions without review.
recommendation_autonomous_financial_deci: Do not automate financial, refund, or billing decisions without authorized review.
recommendation_autonomous_account_access: Do not automate account or access decisions without authorized review.
recommendation_fully_autonomous_workflow: Do not run the workflow fully autonomously without governance.
recommendation_account_access_actions: Require security approval before account or access changes.
recommendation_human_approval_gate: Add a human approval gate before external or high-impact actions.
recommendation_audit_log: Maintain an audit log of inputs, recommendations, reviews, and decisions.
recommendation_data_minimization: Use only the minimum anonymized data needed for the task.
recommendation_least_privilege: Keep permissions narrow and separate recommendation from execution.
architecture_local_streamlit_ui: Local Streamlit interface for input, review, and export.
architecture_deterministic_analyzer: Deterministic analyzer for workflow signals and findings.
architecture_transparent_risk_rules: Transparent risk rules with additive scoring.
architecture_optional_local_llm_enrichme: Optional local LLM enrichment for wording only.
implementation_keep_recommendation_separ: Keep recommendations separate from real-world execution.
implementation_avoid_persistent_storage: Avoid persistent storage of submitted workflow text.
implementation_use_anonymized_inputs: Use anonymized examples and redact sensitive data before analysis.
implementation_document_review_decisions: Document human review decisions and approvals.
implementation_review_integration_bounda: Review integration boundaries before connecting any external system.
implementation_document_failure_handling: Document fallback, retry, escalation, logging, and safe-stop behavior.
implementation_document_appeal_or_recour: Document appeal, recourse, or manual exception paths for affected people or customers.
limitation_keyword_based_detection: Findings are keyword-based and may miss context.
limitation_not_compliance_certification: This report is not legal advice or compliance certification.
limitation_requires_domain_review: Domain owners should review recommendations before implementation.
limitation_not_connected_to_production_s: The MVP does not connect to production systems.
limitation_residual_simulation_hypotheti: Residual simulation is hypothetical unless implementation evidence is reviewed.
limitation_controls_not_proof_of_impleme: Selected controls do not prove implementation.
severity_low_description: Low review priority from local evidence.
severity_medium_description: Moderate review priority; confirm controls before use.
severity_high_description: High review priority; human approval is expected before production use.
severity_critical_description: Critical review priority; do not automate without strong human governance.
severity_unknown_description: Severity could not be determined from available local data.
status_detected_description: Found in submitted text or local evidence.
status_simulated_description: Estimated planning scenario, not observed production state.
status_recommended_description: Proposed local follow-up action, not automatically applied.
status_needs_human_review_description: A responsible human reviewer should verify evidence and decision context.
status_read_only_description: Displayed from local files or saved local records.
status_local_only_description: Runs on this machine without a cloud requirement.
status_not_available_description: Optional capability is unavailable; deterministic app still works.
home_hero_body: Audit AI-assisted business workflows with deterministic local rules, evidence, controls, reports, and optional localhost-only Ollama narrative support.
home_card_no_cloud_body: Deterministic analysis runs locally and exports Markdown or JSON without SaaS dependencies.
home_card_explainable_body: Every score is tied to local evidence, rule factors, meaning, and limitations.
home_card_evidence_body: Findings show source phrases, matched local rules, confidence, and recommended controls.
home_card_exports_body: Reports are portable local files and are saved only after explicit user action.
score_metric_source: Calculated from local deterministic rules and detected workflow evidence.
risk_level_metric_source: Mapped from fixed local score thresholds.
risk_level_metric_limit: Severity is an advisory review priority, not a compliance result.
finding_metric_source: Detected from local text evidence and rule matches.
finding_metric_limit: A human must confirm whether each finding matters.
dashboard_how_to_read: Use Overview for saved local audit signals, Risks for heatmap and evidence, Controls for follow-up items, and History for local audit events.
dashboard_empty_action: You can still inspect the current unsaved analysis if one is open.
dashboard_saved_analyses_meaning: Shows how much local history is available for this dashboard.
dashboard_saved_analyses_limit: Unsaved analyses are not included in saved-history metrics.
dashboard_average_risk_meaning: Higher values suggest more review effort in saved local audits.
dashboard_average_risk_limit: This average is indicative and can be misleading with few reports.
dashboard_simulations_meaning: Shows how often recommended controls were simulated.
dashboard_simulations_limit: Simulations are planning estimates, not implemented remediation.
dashboard_average_reduction_meaning: Shows expected reduction from saved control simulations.
dashboard_average_reduction_limit: It does not prove a control was applied in production.
dashboard_workflow_graph_subtitle: A product map of how the app interprets workflow text locally.
dashboard_heatmap_subtitle: Text-first category by severity view. Counts come from the current analysis when available, otherwise saved local findings.
dashboard_matrix_subtitle: Uses current analysis matrix entries when available. Saved history does not store a full matrix reconstruction.
dashboard_evidence_subtitle: Open one detected risk to see source phrase, rule, confidence, recommended control, and limit.
dashboard_top_controls_subtitle: Most frequently recommended controls in saved local reports.
heatmap_empty_body: Run or save an audit with detected findings to populate this text-first heatmap.
matrix_empty_body: The matrix appears after evidence is mapped to local impact and likelihood attributes.
matrix_cell_limit: Indicative matrix derived from local evidence counts and rule weights.
matrix_current_empty_body: Run an audit in this session to inspect impact and likelihood cells. Saved dashboard history keeps aggregate counts only.
evidence_empty_body: Run an audit first. Saved aggregate metrics do not expose full source phrases in this dashboard panel.
evidence_card_limit: This finding is detected from local text evidence and needs human review before action.
local_issue_tracker_notice: These are local audit follow-up items generated from findings. They are not production tickets and do not prove that remediation was applied.
issue_tracker_subtitle: A lightweight local checklist generated from current findings, not a Jira or production tracker.
issue_tracker_empty_body: Run an audit with findings to generate advisory local follow-up items.
control_checklist_subtitle: Advisory control-readiness view. It does not prove implementation.
control_checklist_empty_body: Run an audit to generate a control checklist from local findings and recommendations.
checklist_human_validation_evidence: Human checkpoints or missing-validation factors from local rules.
checklist_audit_trail_evidence: Audit trail wording or missing-audit factor from the deterministic analysis.
checklist_data_minimization_evidence: Recommended controls and detected sensitive data categories.
checklist_sensitive_data_evidence: Sensitive data categories detected from local workflow text.
checklist_external_review_evidence: External communication factors detected or not detected.
checklist_ollama_local_only_evidence: Ollama is optional and constrained to localhost.
checklist_no_cloud_required_evidence: No cloud API is required for deterministic analysis.
checklist_residual_risk_explained_eviden: Residual risk is shown only after a local simulation.
checklist_report_export_evidence: Markdown and JSON exports remain available.
checklist_human_review_before_production: The app is advisory and not connected to production systems.
checklist_limit: Checklist status is advisory and does not prove implementation.
top_controls_empty_body: Save audits with findings to build a local control frequency summary.
timeline_subtitle: SQLite audit events created by explicit local actions.
timeline_empty_body: Save an audit report locally to populate the audit timeline.
workflow_graph_input_help: Synthetic, example, or anonymized workflow text.
workflow_graph_parser_help: Splits the workflow into local review steps.
workflow_graph_evidence_help: Matches local rules and source phrases.
workflow_graph_report_help: Produces local Markdown and JSON files.
workflow_graph_ai_help: Can draft local wording without changing scores.
workflow_graph_required_note: This graph shows how the local deterministic audit pipeline interprets the workflow. It is not a live production integration map.
reports_how_to_read: Markdown is the human-readable deterministic report. JSON keeps stable technical keys for export while explanatory values remain localized where supported.
reports_deterministic_notice_body: The saved report is generated from local deterministic analysis. Optional local AI narrative may appear only as wording assistance and does not change scores.
reports_json_notice: JSON keeps stable English technical keys for automation; explanatory fields may be localized.
kb_read_only_body: This Knowledge Base is loaded from local JSON files and seeded into local SQLite. It is not a cloud database and this screen does not edit rules.
kb_metric_source: Loaded from local JSON and local SQLite seed data.
kb_metric_meaning: Shows the size of the read-only local rule library.
kb_metric_limit: Counts do not imply coverage or certification.
kb_rule_limit: Rule match is advisory and can miss context.
kb_control_limit: Recommended control is not automatically applied.
demo_scenarios_explainer_body: Demo scenarios are synthetic local examples for learning and screenshots. They are not user saved data and do not connect to production systems.
accessibility_note_body: Colors are only a secondary signal. Badges, heatmap cells, and matrix cells include text labels, counts, source, meaning, and limits.
explanation_local_first_body: Analysis, storage, reports, and exports stay on the local machine unless you explicitly use a localhost Ollama model for advisory wording.
explanation_residual_risk_body: Residual risk is a local hypothetical simulation after selected controls. It supports planning but does not prove implementation or guarantee reduction.
explanation_risk_score_body: The risk score is a deterministic local indicator from mapped evidence and rule weights. It is not a calibrated probability or compliance decision.
explanation_auditability_body: Auditability means findings keep source evidence, local rules, limits, and reviewer questions visible enough to challenge.
explanation_knowledge_base_body: The knowledge base is read-only local reference data for rules, controls, categories, and explanations. It does not certify coverage.
local_ai_how_to_read: This page shows what Ollama can add locally, what it cannot add, and the exact prompt/response when a local model is used.
local_ai_status_source: Checked against the localhost Ollama tags endpoint.
local_ai_status_limit: If unavailable, the app remains fully deterministic.
local_ai_endpoint_meaning: Only localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1 endpoints are accepted by the client.
local_ai_endpoint_limit: Remote endpoints are rejected and are not used as fallback.
local_ai_models_limit: Model availability does not validate scores or findings.
local_ai_cloud_block_source: Detected from model metadata or cloud-like names.
local_ai_cloud_block_meaning: Cloud/proxy models are blocked for local-only enrichment.
local_ai_cloud_block_limit: The app never falls back to a cloud model.
local_ai_score_guardrail: Local AI output never changes deterministic findings, scores, controls, or residual-risk simulation.
local_ai_does_not_add_title: What local AI does not add
local_ai_synthetic_test_subtitle: This test uses only synthetic text and shows the exact prompt before sending.
local_ai_synthetic_deterministic_summary: Deterministic audit remains available even if this synthetic local AI test is not run or fails.
local_ai_current_report_title: Generate local narrative for current report
local_ai_current_report_subtitle: Uses current workflow text only when you explicitly click the button and only with a listed local model.
local_ai_generate_current: Generate local narrative for current report
local_ai_no_current_analysis_body: Run an audit first to generate an optional local narrative for the current report.
local_ai_comparison_title: Deterministic report vs local AI narrative
local_ai_no_response_body: Ollama may be unavailable, no local model may be installed, or the request was not run.
settings_bar_body: Language and appearance are display settings only. They do not change deterministic analysis.
theme_system_fallback_note: System appearance remains an internal compatibility mode; the product controls prioritize Light and Dark.
loading_deterministic_body: The deterministic engine is reviewing evidence. No cloud call. No score is final yet.
loading_local_ai_body: Local AI can draft wording only. Scores, findings, controls and simulation stay deterministic.
loading_simulation_body: Selected controls are hypothetical until implementation evidence proves they exist.
loading_export_body: Markdown and JSON are generated from deterministic local results.
loading_report_body: The report is generated locally from deterministic findings and evidence.
issue_control_fallback: Review the finding and decide whether a control is needed.
dashboard_section_executive_overview_sub: Current posture, evidence volume, local-only status, report readiness, and residual simulation state.
dashboard_section_risk_posture_subtitle: Severity distribution and impact context from current or saved local evidence.
dashboard_section_findings_evidence_subt: Localized filters, evidence cards, source phrases, and advisory limits.
dashboard_section_controls_followup_subt: Advisory checklist, follow-up items, and top controls without production-ticket claims.
dashboard_section_local_history_subtitle: Saved reports, timeline events, and trends stored in local SQLite only.
exec_risk_level_meaning: Highest visible review priority for the current cockpit view.
exec_risk_level_limit: Advisory priority only; not a compliance decision.
exec_findings_count_source: Detected text evidence and saved aggregate counts.
exec_findings_count_meaning: Shows how many attention points need review.
exec_findings_count_limit: A finding is a signal, not proof by itself.
exec_human_review_source: Derived from severity and current evidence.
exec_human_review_meaning: Flags whether a responsible reviewer should inspect context before use.
exec_human_review_limit: The app cannot approve or reject production use.
exec_local_only_source: Deterministic rules, local files, and local SQLite.
exec_local_only_meaning: The core audit runs on this machine without a cloud API.
exec_local_only_limit: Only explicit optional Ollama calls can use localhost models.
exec_report_readiness_source: Current generated Markdown and JSON export state.
exec_report_readiness_meaning: Shows whether the current analysis has a report preview/export prepared.
exec_report_readiness_limit: Local history is created only after explicit save.
exec_residual_simulation_source: Local simulation from selected mapped controls.
exec_residual_simulation_meaning: Shows planning impact after selected safeguards when available.
exec_residual_simulation_limit: Simulation does not prove controls were implemented.
score_simple_with_factors: {level} estimated risk from local rules, mainly because {categories} were detected in the workflow text.
score_simple_without_factors: Low estimated risk because no weighted risk factors were detected in the workflow text.
score_certainty_label: Indicative only; not calibrated as a real-world probability.
calculation_formula: Raw matrix score = sum of mapped local risk-factor weights. Residual risk = raw score minus simulated selected-control reductions.
top_risk_plain_template: The workflow may be risky because the text contains evidence related to {category}. A human should check whether this finding is relevant.
control_reason_fallback: Recommended because a local risk rule matched the workflow.
control_expected_effect: May reduce the simulated residual score if selected; not a guarantee.
simulation_not_run_summary: No residual-risk simulation was run. Any residual risk number would be simulated, not detected.
simulation_run_summary: Raw risk {raw_score} becomes simulated residual risk {residual_score} after selected hypothetical protections, for a simulated reduction of {reduction}. This is not proof of implementation or a guarantee.
limitation_false_positive_context: Keyword and regex findings can produce false positives or miss context.
limitation_score_not_probability: Scores are deterministic indicators, not measured real-world probabilities.
limitation_residual_not_assurance: Residual risk is simulated planning output, not production assurance.
limitation_human_review_required: A responsible human must review evidence, recommendations, and decisions.
raw_matrix_explanation_fallback: Raw risk is calculated from local rule weights mapped to detected evidence.
simulation_not_proof_warning: Selected controls are hypothetical unless implementation evidence proves they exist and are used. Simulation is not a guarantee.
no_controls_mapped_report: No controls mapped from detected evidence.
control_expected_effect_short: may reduce mapped risk in simulation; not a guarantee.
no_validation_checkpoint_report: No high-impact checkpoint was generated from the workflow text.
report_local_privacy_line_analysis: Analysis runs locally from the workflow text supplied in the app.
report_local_privacy_line_save: User workflow text is saved only after an explicit local save action.
report_local_privacy_line_sqlite: Saved workflows, assessments, simulations, and reports are stored in local SQLite.
report_local_privacy_line_no_cloud: The app does not require a cloud API and does not send workflow text to a cloud service.
report_local_privacy_line_ollama: Optional Ollama enrichment remains local-only and does not change deterministic scoring.
report_executive_summary_template: Deterministic local audit result: {level} risk / {score}. {summary} The compatibility score is {compatibility}; the risk matrix raw score is {raw_score}.
report_detected_count_template: {count} findings were detected in the submitted text. Detected means the evidence appeared in the workflow text or matched a local pattern.
no_mapped_control_recommendation: No mapped control recommendation was generated from the detected evidence.
risk_matrix_report_explanation: Raw risk is the deterministic sum of mapped factor weights. Likelihood and impact are explainable matrix attributes derived from evidence counts and factor weights.
raw_matrix_score_explanation_report: This is calculated by summing local risk-factor weights mapped from evidence.
severity_thresholds_sentence: Severity comes from fixed thresholds: low 0-4, medium 5-9, high 10-15, critical 16+.
compatibility_score_explanation: This preserves the original deterministic analyzer score for compatibility.
compatibility_level_explanation: Use the raw matrix score for the explainable report narrative.
review_workflow_manually_report: Review the workflow manually and decide whether additional controls are needed.
simulation_local_explanation_report: Residual risk is a local simulation based on mapped control effects. Selected controls are hypothetical unless evidenced. It does not execute actions or guarantee production risk reduction.
no_residual_simulation_report: No residual simulation has been saved for this report. Simulation is local planning only.
roadmap_review_evidence: Review evidence with the responsible business owner.
roadmap_document_residual: Select controls and document residual risk assumptions.
roadmap_human_approval: Require human approval before external, people-affecting, or irreversible steps.
roadmap_security_review: Treat any future production integration as a separate security review.
report_generated_locally_line: Report generated locally. Persistence occurs only after explicit save actions.
checkpoint_confirm_appeal_or_recourse: Confirm an appeal, recourse, or manual exception path.
checkpoint_confirm_fallback_or_manual_qu: Confirm fallback, manual queue, rollback, or safe-stop behavior.
privacy_risk_refund_payment_data_in_work: Refund or payment data in workflow
risk_cockpit_subtitle: Live deterministic posture for this session. Color reinforces labels but never replaces them.
cockpit_human_note: The engine does not approve production use
cockpit_saved_note: Persistence occurs only after explicit save
simulation_assumptions_not_proof: Selected controls are assumptions, not proof. Verify evidence and implementation before relying on this result.
local_ai_authority_body: Deterministic findings and score remain the source of truth.
local_ai_capability_body: Draft explanations, missing-context prompts, and reviewer questions.
analysis_empty_state_body: Paste an anonymized workflow or choose a synthetic example from the workflow source selector.
analysis_empty_state_detail: AIWRA cannot score, infer evidence, or recommend controls until input exists.
workflow_optional_import_caption: Optional local import is secondary; pasting text remains the main path.
workflow_file_uploader_help: Optional local text import for this session.
workflow_file_decode_error: This file could not be decoded as UTF-8 text. Paste anonymized text manually instead.
workflow_action_row_hint: Actions affect only this local session unless you explicitly save a report.
analysis_input_state_body: The workflow text is in session memory only until you explicitly save a local report.
analysis_input_state_detail: Click Analyze Workflow to run the local deterministic engine.
analysis_error_state_body: The deterministic engine returned an application error. No public stack trace is shown; adjust the input or retry with a smaller anonymized workflow.
analysis_error_state_detail: No score, finding, evidence, control, or simulation was created from the failed run.
analysis_error_public_message: Analysis stopped before producing a deterministic result. No score or evidence was created.
analysis_success_state_body: {count} evidence-linked finding(s) are available for review.
analysis_success_state_detail: Review evidence and recommended controls before saving or exporting.
deterministic_ready_body: Evidence-linked findings are available for review.
deterministic_ready_detail: Local AI can help draft wording only and never changes deterministic results.
analysis_partial_no_findings_body: The deterministic engine did not map this input to risk findings. That is an honest empty result, not proof that the workflow is safe.
analysis_partial_no_findings_detail: Consider adding more process detail before relying on the absence of findings.
controls_partial_empty_body: The current deterministic output did not include recommended controls. The UI will not invent controls or mark remediation as applied.
controls_partial_empty_detail: Add more workflow details or review the evidence manually if controls are still expected.
export_state_body: Markdown and JSON are generated locally from the deterministic result.
export_state_detail: Downloading does not save local history. Saving is explicit and writes to local SQLite.
post_analysis_actions_body: Jump directly to evidence, simulation, reports, or optional localhost-only AI without changing deterministic results.
post_action_evidence_help: Open the risk cockpit evidence view for source phrases, rules, and limits.
post_action_simulation_help: Open the local hypothetical residual-risk controls.
post_action_reports_help: Open saved local reports, Markdown, JSON, and audit trail.
post_action_local_ai_help: Open optional Ollama prompt and response display. This never changes scores.
simulation_inline_subtitle: Select recommended controls to model a hypothetical local residual-risk result. This does not apply controls.
desktop_launcher_local_only: Desktop launch remains bound to 127.0.0.1 without sudo.
shutdown_system_caption: Shut down the local AIWRA system.
shutdown_system_notice: Shutdown requested. The local server is stopping.
